crossRefs.note: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;

translations.web: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;
translations.bsb: That is why we said, ‘Let us take action and build an altar for ourselves, but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices.
translations.kjv: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
translations.asv: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt-offering, nor for sacrifice:
